_readme: Site-wide settings. Only the values an owner has to change live here. brand.* is used by the pages, the posters and the SEO templates.

brand.name: RozgarJobs
brand.tagline: Jobs in Pakistan, updated every hour

analytics._readme: Leave empty to keep the site 100% cookieless with no third-party calls.

supabase._readme: Create a project at supabase.com, run supabase/schema.sql, then paste the Project URL and the anon public key here. The anon key is designed to be public — Row Level Security protects the data. Never put the service_role key in this file.
